raw_snippet: In the suit, Amazon accused Perplexity of covertly accessing private Amazon customer accounts through its Comet browser and associated AI agent, and of disguising automated activity as human browsing.
value_text: Amazon sues Perplexity to stop its Comet browser's agent shopping on Amazon (Nov 2025)
note: Reuters via Insurance Journal: filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California.
